name: knix-wayland

seat_provider.rule: the compositor runs as knix through the guest's own seatd; both wlroots backends must be listed or libinput is never loaded; virtio input devices need a guest-owned seat tag

autostart.fallback: GPU=none leaves the DRM condition unmet; the serial console and ssh remain the full fallback path

resilience.verification: build.sh --build sends SIGKILL to the compositor and requires guest systemd to bring back a knix-owned sway with DRM, libinput and a real Wayland client before writing the receipt
resilience.fallback: GPU=none keeps the DRM condition unmet; repeated crashes stop at the systemd start limit and leave the serial console and ssh available

crash_loop.verification: verify-graphics.sh deliberately sends SIGKILL until guest systemd refuses another restart, then requires ActiveState=failed, zero sway processes, exactly one failed unit (the session unit itself), ssh and the serial console intact, and a complete knix-owned session recovered by guest systemd
crash_loop.fallback: a crash loop leaves the serial console and ssh as the full fallback path; guest systemd stops the loop instead of burning CPU forever

fallback: the guest's own systemd target starts the session at boot when the DRM device exists; GPU=none leaves that condition unmet and keeps the serial console and ssh available
